name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie flat on bench. Grip bar slightly wider than shoulder-width. Lower bar to mid-chest. Push explosively up.
commonMistakes: Bouncing bar off chest, flaring elbows out at 90 degrees.

name: Dumbbell Incline Bench Press
instructions: Set bench to 30-45 degree incline. Press dumbbells straight up from upper chest level.
commonMistakes: Setting bench angle too high, turning it into a shoulder press.

name: Push-Up
instructions: Place hands shoulder-width apart. Maintain straight body plank. Lower chest to floor and push back up.
commonMistakes: Sagging hips, head drooping down.

name: Cable Chest Fly
instructions: Stand in center of cable machine. Bring handles together in a hugging motion keeping elbow angle soft.
commonMistakes: Bending elbows too much turning fly into press.

name: Dumbbell Pullover
instructions: Lie perpendicular across a flat bench. Hold dumbbell with both hands over chest. Lower weight back over head.
commonMistakes: Bending knees excessively or letting hips sag.

name: Barbell Deadlift
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width under bar. Hinge at hips, grip bar, keep spine neutral. Drive through heels to stand upright.
commonMistakes: Rounding lower back, jerking the bar off ground.

name: Pull-Up
instructions: Grip bar with palms facing away. Pull chest up to bar engaging lats. Lower down smoothly.
commonMistakes: Using momentum or swinging legs, partial reps.

name: Bent-Over Barbell Row
instructions: Hinge hips to 45 degrees. Pull barbell toward belly button keeping elbows close to body.
commonMistakes: Standing up too tall, using momentum.

name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit at lat pulldown machine. Pull bar down to upper chest while squeezing shoulder blades.
commonMistakes: Leaning back excessively, pulling bar behind neck.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
instructions: Support knee and hand on bench. Row dumbbell up to hip level, lower under control.
commonMistakes: Rotating torso, twisting spine.

name: Barbell Back Squat
instructions: Place bar across upper traps. Hinge hips and bend knees until thighs parallel to floor. Drive up.
commonMistakes: Knees caving inward, lifting heels.

name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hold bar at thigh level. Hinge hips back with slight knee bend until stretch felt in hamstrings.
commonMistakes: Rounding lower back, bending knees too much.

name: Leg Press
instructions: Place feet hip-width on sled. Lower platform toward chest to 90 degrees, press back up.
commonMistakes: Locking knees at top, letting lower back lift off pad.

name: Walking Dumbbell Lunge
instructions: Step forward with dumbbell in each hand. Lower back knee toward floor. Push off front heel to step into next lunge.
commonMistakes: Knee extending beyond toes, leaning forward.

name: Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Place balls of feet on step edge. Lower heels for stretch, press up onto toes forcefully.
commonMistakes: Bouncing, rushing through partial range of motion.

name: Overhead Dumbbell Press
instructions: Sit or stand with dumbbells at shoulder height. Press upward until arms fully extended over head.
commonMistakes: Arching lower back, flaring elbows back.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at sides. Raise arms out to sides until parallel with floor with soft elbow bend.
commonMistakes: Shrugging shoulders, using torso momentum.

name: Face Pull
instructions: Attach rope to high pulley. Pull rope towards nose while splitting rope ends and externally rotating shoulders.
commonMistakes: Pulling bar down to neck instead of face, rushing.

name: Barbell Biceps Curl
instructions: Hold bar underhand shoulder-width. Keep elbows pinned to sides, curl weight to shoulder height.
commonMistakes: Swinging hips, moving elbows forward.

name: Triceps Dip
instructions: Grip dip bars, lower body until upper arms parallel to floor. Push up forcefully.
commonMistakes: Dipping too deep causing shoulder strain.

name: Cable Triceps Pushdown
instructions: Grip rope or bar attachment at chest height. Extend elbows fully down while keeping upper arms fixed.
commonMistakes: Flaring elbows outward, letting shoulders roll forward.

name: Plank Hold
instructions: Rest on forearms and toes. Keep head, spine, and hips in a straight line while pulling belly button inward.
commonMistakes: Sagging lower back, sticking butt in air.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
instructions: Hang from pull-up bar. Raise legs straight up to 90 degrees without swinging.
commonMistakes: Swinging legs using momentum.

name: Russian Twist
instructions: Sit on floor with knees bent, lean torso back 45 degrees. Twist torso side to side touching hands or weight.
commonMistakes: Moving only arms without rotating shoulder girdle.

name: Treadmill Interval Running
instructions: Alternate between 1 minute sprint at high speed and 1 minute recovery jog/walk.
commonMistakes: Holding onto treadmill handrails while running.

name: Jumping Rope
instructions: Hold handles at waist height. Jump smoothly on balls of feet as rope passes beneath.
commonMistakes: Jumping too high, bending knees excessively.

name: Burpees
instructions: From standing, drop into pushup position, perform pushup, snap feet forward and jump up explosively.
commonMistakes: Arching lower back on pushup portion.

name: Cat-Cow Stretch
instructions: On hands and knees, arch spine up like a cat while exhaling, then dip belly low and lift head while inhaling.
commonMistakes: Forcing movement beyond comfortable range.

name: Doorway Pectoral Stretch
instructions: Place forearm against door frame at 90 degrees. Lean forward gently until stretch is felt in chest.
commonMistakes: Twisting hips or forcing joint.

name: Band External Shoulder Rotation
instructions: Attach band at waist height. Keep elbow pinned to waist at 90 degrees, rotate forearm outward.
commonMistakes: Moving elbow away from body side.
